title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company (HPE) Ex-Dividend Date Scheduled for June 12, 2018
text:
Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company (HPE) Ex-Dividend Date Scheduled for June 12, 2018 June 11, 2018, 09:00:06 AM
Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company ( HPE ) will begin trading ex-dividend on June 12, 2018. A cash dividend payment of $0.112 per share is scheduled to be paid on July 04, 2018. Shareholders who purchased HPE prior to the ex-dividend date are eligible for the cash dividend payment. This represents an 49.33% increase over prior dividend payment. At the current stock price of $16.01, the dividend yield is 2.8%.
The previous trading day's last sale of HPE was $16.01, representing a -17.79% decrease from the 52 week high of $19.48 and a 24.93% increase over the 52 week low of $12.82.
HPE is a part of the Technology sector, which includes companies such as Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) and International Business Machines Corporation ( IBM ). HPE's current earnings per share, an indicator of a company's profitability, is $1.8. Zacks Investment Research reports HPE's forecasted earnings growth in 2018 as 53.44%, compared to an industry average of 22.2%.
For more information on the declaration, record and payment dates, visit the HPE Dividend History page. Our Dividend Calendar has the full list of stocks that have an ex-dividend today.
Interested in gaining exposure to HPE through an Exchange Traded Fund [ETF]? The following ETF(s) have HPE as a top-10 holding: SPDR S&P Technology Hardware ETF ( XTH ).
The top-performing ETF of this group is XTH with an increase of 3.45% over the last 100 days. It also has the highest percent weighting of HPE at 2.47%.
